items.title: ConocoPhillips (COP) Gives Finance Chief Role To Insider Kontessa Haynes Welsh
items.summary: ConocoPhillips (NYSE:COP) has appointed Kontessa S. Haynes-Welsh as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. The leadership change reflects internal advancement within the existing ConocoPhillips executive team. The new CFO role places Haynes-Welsh at the center of the company’s financial planning, reporting and capital allocation decisions.
